# Misty Bliss – Artisanal Home Décor & Modern Living
> Thoughtfully curated artisanal ceramics, stoneware vessels, botanical arrangements, handcrafted lighting, and tactile interior accessories.

Website: https://mistybliss.com
Contact: concierge@mistybliss.com
Headquarters: Portland Studio & Dhaka Workshop
Free Shipping: Complimentary carbon-neutral express shipping on orders over $75.
Returns: 30-day hassle-free returns with prepaid return labels.

---

## Brand Ethos & Materials
Misty Bliss creates timeless home accents that foster calm, mindful living. Every piece celebrates tactile honesty, neutral earthy palettes (terracotta #C77F79, warm cream, raw sand, deep charcoal), and organic silhouettes.
- **Stoneware & Ceramics**: Hand-thrown high-fired grogged stoneware, terracotta, and porcelain with food-safe and water-tight matte glazes.
- **Botanicals**: Hyper-realistic faux florals, dried natural pampas, and sculptural preserved eucalyptus.
- **Lighting**: Honed travertine bases, brushed solid brass hardware, and pleated raw linen shades.
- **Textiles**: 100% Belgian washed linen, tactile bouclé, and alpaca wool throws.
- **Stone & Marble**: Natural Italian travertine, beige travertine catchalls, and scalloped marble centerpieces.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems
Q: Does Misty Bliss ship internationally?
A: Yes, we ship worldwide with carbon-neutral courier delivery. US/UK/EU orders over $75 qualify for free shipping.

Q: Are Misty Bliss ceramic vases waterproof?
A: Yes. All functional ceramic vases have glazed interiors tested for watertight durability, making them suitable for fresh flower arrangements as well as dried stems.

Q: How can customers contact customer service?
A: Through our on-site live concierge chat widget, WhatsApp direct line, or by emailing concierge@mistybliss.com.
